verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: The son of man was sent to the prophets of Israel who were prophesying. And you said to those prophets, “Listen to the words of Jehovah.”
verses.3: So said Adonai Yehovah: “May those prophets who go after their own desires be punished! I will not see them again.”
verses.4: When your prophets suffered in destruction, O Israel!
verses.5: You did not go up into the hills; instead, Gideon led the people of Israel into battle on the day of Jehovah.
verses.6: They saw that they were like foolish people. They said, “Let us cry out to the Lord.” But the Lord did not send them, and they were unable to carry out His words.
verses.7: Do not expect to see their beauty or charm. They are nothing but deceivers. They say, “Hear, O LORD!” But I have never spoken such words.
verses.8: Therefore, I say, Adonai Yehovah: Because your words are false and your actions are deceitful, I am speaking to you now. Adonai Yehovah, please have mercy on us.
verses.9: And my hands will be among the prophets who are prophets of dreams and illusions. They will not be able to do anything in my people’s land. They will not be written down in the records of Israel. They will not come into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.10: And in their error, they led my people astray. They said, “There is no peace.” But he is the one who brings peace. Yet they still reject him.
verses.11: Say to the clouds, “Fall!” Then it will be a flood that will sweep over everything. The rocks of Elgabish will also fall. The winds of storms will blow everywhere.
verses.12: And behold, the wall has fallen down! Now it is said to you: “Who is the builder who built this wall?”
verses.13: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: My soul is troubled in my anger; floods flood over me. And the rocks of Elgavish will be burned in my wrath for all of them.
verses.14: And I destroyed the walls that they had built. I brought them down to the ground, and all their structures collapsed. And you knew that I was Jehovah.
verses.15: And I tried to hold onto my faith in those walls and in those places of safety. But I said to you, there are no walls, and there are no places of safety at all.
verses.16: The prophets of Israel who are brought to Jerusalem, and those who see visions for it… There is no peace, says the Lord God.
verses.17: And you, son of Adam, turn your face towards your people’s daughters who are being born from them.
verses.18: And you said, “Thus it is said: ‘O Lord Jehovah, let there be a separation between those who do evil deeds and those who do good deeds. Let those who do evil deeds be punished, and let those who do good deeds be rewarded.’”
verses.19: And they began to kill me among my people, at the gates and in the gates of the storehouses. They killed those souls who did not die, and they kept alive those souls who did not live in their graves. My people heard this and were horrified.
verses.20: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will bring your souls there, where you have placed them to make them bloom. I will take those souls from among your branches, and I will send those souls who are among your branches to bloom.”
verses.21: And I will tear apart your borders, and I will save my people from your hands. They will no longer be in your control. And you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.22: For the heart of the righteous is wounded by falsehood. I do not hurt him. And to strengthen the hands of the wicked, so that they will not return from their evil path and live again.
verses.23: Therefore, let us not be deceived by appearances. Let us not be misled by false appearances. I have saved my people from their enemies. Know that I am Jehovah.
